_comment: Retrieval eval seed. Each case: a query and the title substrings of items that SHOULD rank in the top-k. Grow this as you dogfood — it's how retrieval changes get measured instead of vibe-checked.

corpus.text: We decided to use Stripe over Razorpay because of better international SDK support.
All payment errors must be logged to Sentry. This is non-negotiable.
Webhook events to handle: payment_intent.succeeded and payment_intent.failed.
Verify the Stripe signature using the STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var.
Considered Postgres vs SQLite for storage; leaning SQLite for local-first simplicity.
Auth uses short-lived JWTs with refresh tokens stored httpOnly.
The frontend is a React SPA served as static files from the API.
